expectations.says: The weight is written as a body weight of 9.979 kilograms.
expectations.query: SELECT m.value_as_number, m.unit_concept_id FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000911' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3025315

expectations.says: The anaesthetic table gives the anaesthetic no weight, because its rule looks only from seven days before the start to the end.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000931' AND a.weight_kg IS NULL
